en.s: The Battle of Marathon took place in 490 BCE during the first Persian invasion of Greece. It was fought between the citizens of Athens, aided by Plataea, against a Persian force commanded by Datis and Artaphernes. The battle was the culmination of the first attempt by Persia under King Darius I to subjugate Greece. The Greek army inflicted a crushing defeat on the more numerous Persians, marking a turning point in the Greco-Persian Wars.

zh.s: 马拉松战役发生于公元前490年第一次波斯入侵希腊期间。雅典公民在普拉提亚援军帮助下，与波斯军队交战，波斯军由达提斯和阿尔塔费尼斯统率。此役是波斯国王大流士一世首次试图征服希腊的收官之战。希腊军队以少胜多，重创波斯军队，成为希波战争的转折点。

en.s: The Battle of Portopí (12 September 1229) was an open field military conflict between the Almohad troops that occupied the island of Majorca and the Christian army led by King James I the Conqueror with the aim of annexing it to the Crown of Aragon in order to expand their domain and return it back to Christiandom.

zh.s: 波托皮战役于1229年9月12日爆发，是一场野战。占据马略卡岛的穆瓦希德军队与征服者海梅一世率领的基督教军队交战；后者意图吞并该岛，将其并入阿拉贡王国，扩展领土并使其重新归属基督教世界。

en.s: The Treaty of Alcañices or Treaty of Alcanises was signed in Alcañices between King Denis of Portugal and King Fernando IV of Castile in 1297. Denis was the grandson of King Alfonso X of Castile and essentially an administrator and not a warrior king. He went to war with the kingdom of Castile in 1295, relinquishing the villages of Serpa and Moura, but gained Olivença and reaffirmed Portugal's possession of the Algarve and defined the modern borders between the two Iberian countries.
en.n: The Treaty of Alcañices, mediated by the pope, between the king Denis of Portugal and king Ferdinand IV of Castile defines the border between the two countries and establishes an alliance of friendship.

zh.s: 阿尔卡尼斯条约又称阿尔卡尼斯协定，于1297年在阿尔卡尼斯由葡萄牙国王迪尼斯与卡斯蒂利亚国王斐迪南四世签署。迪尼斯是卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索十世的孙子，主要擅长行政而非军事。1295年，他曾与卡斯蒂利亚开战，放弃塞尔帕和莫拉村镇，但获得奥利文萨，并重申葡萄牙对阿尔加维的主权，确立了伊比利亚两国今天的边界。
zh.n: 这项由教皇斡旋的条约由葡萄牙国王迪尼斯与卡斯蒂利亚国王斐迪南四世签署，划定两国边界并建立友好同盟。

en.t: Reconquista: Castilian forces captured Gibraltar from the Emirate of Granada
en.s: The first siege of Gibraltar was a battle of the Spanish Reconquista that took place in 1309. The battle pitted the forces of the Crown of Castile (mostly those from the military councils of the city of Seville) under the command of Juan Núñez II de Lara and Alonso Pérez de Guzmán, against the forces of the Emirate of Granada who were under the command of Sultan Muhammed III and his brother, Abu'l-Juyush Nasr.

en.s: The naval Battle of the Abrolhos took place on 12 September 1631 off the coast of Pernambuco, Brazil, during the Eighty Years' War. A joint Spanish-Portuguese fleet under admiral Antonio de Oquendo defeated the Dutch after a six-hour naval battle.

zh.s: 阿布罗柳斯海战于1631年9月12日在巴西伯南布哥海岸外爆发，是八十年战争的一部分。安东尼奥·德·奥肯多海军上将率领西班牙与葡萄牙联合舰队，在一场持续6小时的海战后击败荷兰舰队。

en.s: On 12 September 1634, a Hospitaller gunpowder factory in Valletta, Malta accidentally blew up, killing 22 people and causing severe damage to a number of buildings. The factory had been built at some time in the late 16th or early 17th centuries, replacing an earlier one in Fort St. Angelo in Birgu. It was located in the lower part of Valletta, close to the Slaves' Prison. The explosion damaged the nearby Jesuit church and college. The church's façade was rebuilt in around 1647 by the architect Francesco Buonamici, while the damaged parts of the college were also rebuilt after the explosion.

zh.s: 1634年9月12日，马耳他瓦莱塔的一家医院骑士团火药厂意外爆炸，造成22人死亡，多栋建筑严重受损。该厂建于16世纪末或17世纪初，取代了比尔古圣安杰洛堡内较早的一家火药厂，位于瓦莱塔低处，靠近奴隶监狱。爆炸还损坏了附近的耶稣会教堂和学院。教堂立面约于1647年由建筑师弗朗切斯科·布奥纳米奇重建，学院受损部分也在爆炸后修复。

en.s: The siege of Philippsburg (25 August – 12 September 1644) was a French siege of the Rhine fortress of Philippsburg during the Thirty Years' War. After the battle of Freiburg in early August, the French under the Duc d'Enghien refrained from attacking the city and marched north to besiege the imperial-held Philippsburg instead. The place fell after a two-week siege.

en.s: The Battle of Vienna (German: Schlacht am Kahlen Berge or Kahlenberg; Polish: bitwa pod Wiedniem or odsiecz wiedeńska; Modern Turkish: İkinci Viyana Kuşatması, Ottoman Turkish: Beç Ḳalʿası Muḥāṣarası) took place at Kahlenberg Mountain near Vienna on 12 September 1683 after the imperial city had been besieged by the Ottoman Empire for two months. The battle was fought by the Habsburg Monarchy, the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth and the Holy Roman Empire, under the command of King John III Sobieski against the invading Muslim Ottoman Empire and its vassal and tributary states.

zh.s: 维也纳战役又称卡伦山战役（德语：Schlacht am Kahlen Berge或Kahlenberg；波兰语：bitwa pod Wiedniem或odsiecz wiedeńska；现代土耳其语：İkinci Viyana Kuşatması；奥斯曼土耳其语：Beç Ḳalʿası Muḥāṣarası），于1683年9月12日在维也纳附近的卡伦山爆发。此前奥斯曼帝国已围困这座帝国城市两个月。扬三世·索别斯基国王统率哈布斯堡君主国、波兰立陶宛联邦和神圣罗马帝国联军，迎战入侵的奥斯曼帝国及其附庸和纳贡国。

en.s: The Polish–Ottoman War or the War of the Holy League was the Polish side of the conflict that is otherwise known as the Great Turkish War. The conflict began with a Polish victory at the Battle of Vienna in 1683 and ended with the Treaty of Karlowitz, which restored to the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth lands lost in the previous Polish–Ottoman War (1672–76)).

en.s: The siege of Landau took place from 16 June to 12 September 1702, during the War of the Spanish Succession. An Imperial army led by Louis William, Margrave of Baden-Baden captured Landau, a fortress town in the Rhineland-Palatinate held by a French garrison commanded by the Comte de Mélac. The earliest actions from the war were focused in northern Italy in 1701, but military activity began in the Electoral Palatinate the following year.

Marlborough and François Nicolas Fagel broke through the French defensive lines and took Bouchain after a siege of 34 days.

en.s: The Battle of Berby was fought on 12 September 1808, between Swedish and Norwegian forces, during the Dano-Swedish War of 1808–09. Ever since the Battle of Prestebakke, the western front had been relatively calm, until colonel Posse launched a reconnaissance towards the Norwegian positions around at Berby, under Andreas Samuel Krebs; the Swedes pushed the Norwegians in front of them, all the way to Berby itself, where the Norwegians made a sturdy hold.

zh.s: 贝尔比战役于1808年9月12日在丹麦—瑞典战争期间爆发，交战双方为瑞典和挪威军队。自普雷斯特巴克战役以来，西线一直相对平静，直到波塞上校在安德烈亚斯·萨缪尔·克雷布斯率领的挪威阵地附近发动侦察行动。瑞典军队一路将挪威军队逼退至贝尔比，挪威军队在那里顽强坚守。

en.s: The Battle of North Point was an engagement in the War of 1812, fought on September 12, 1814, between Brigadier General John Stricker's Third Brigade of the Maryland State Militia and a British landing force, composed of units from the British Army, Royal Navy seamen and Royal Marines, and led by Major General Robert Ross and Rear Admiral George Cockburn. The events and result of the engagement, a part of the larger Battle of Baltimore, saw the U.S. forces retreating after having inflicted heavy casualties on the British. One of the casualties was Ross, killed during the course of the battle by American sharpshooters.

zh.s: 北角战役是1812年战争期间的一场交战，于1814年9月12日爆发。交战双方是约翰·斯特里克准将率领的马里兰州民兵第3旅，以及罗伯特·罗斯少将和乔治·科克伯恩海军少将率领的英国登陆部队；英军由英国陆军部队、皇家海军水兵和皇家海军陆战队组成。这场交战是规模更大的巴尔的摩战役的一部分。美军在给英军造成重大伤亡后撤退，英军伤亡者中包括在战斗中被美国神枪手击毙的罗斯。

en.s: The Battle of Chapultepec took place between U.S. troops and Mexican forces holding the strategically located Chapultepec Castle on the outskirts of Mexico City on September 13, 1847 during the Mexican–American War. The castle was built atop a 200-foot (61 m) hill in 1783, and in 1833 it was converted into a military academy and a gunpowder storage facility. The hill was surrounded by a wall 1,600 yards long.

en.s: The rise of federalism in Switzerland began on 12 September 1848, with the creation of a federal constitution in response to a 27-day civil war, the Sonderbundskrieg. The 1848 constitution represented the first time, other than when the short-lived Helvetic Republic had been imposed, that the Swiss had a central government instead of being simply a collection of autonomous cantons bound by treaties.

en.s: The Battle of Harpers Ferry was fought September 12–15, 1862, as part of the Maryland Campaign of the American Civil War. As Gen. Robert E. Lee's Confederate army invaded Maryland, a portion of his army under Maj. Gen. Thomas J. "Stonewall" Jackson surrounded, bombarded, and captured the Union garrison at Harpers Ferry, Virginia (now West Virginia), a major victory at relatively minor cost. en.s: The Battle of Edson's Ridge, also known as the Battle of the Bloody Ridge, Battle of Raiders Ridge, and Battle of the Ridge, was a land battle of the Pacific campaign of World War II between Imperial Japanese Army and Allied (mainly United States Marine Corps) ground forces. It took place from 12–14 September 1942, on Guadalcanal in the Solomon Islands, and was the second of three separate major Japanese ground offensives during the Guadalcanal Campaign. In the battle, U.S. Marines, under the overall command of U.S. Major General Alexander Vandegrift, repulsed an attack by the Japanese 35th Infantry Brigade, under the command of Japanese Major General Kiyotake Kawaguchi.

zh.s: 埃德森岭战役又称血岭战役、突袭者岭战役或山脊战役，是第二次世界大战太平洋战场上的一场陆战，交战双方为日本帝国陆军与盟军地面部队（主要是美国海军陆战队）。战斗于1942年9月12日至14日在所罗门群岛瓜达尔卡纳尔岛进行，是瓜达尔卡纳尔战役期间日军三次大规模陆上攻势中的第二次。亚历山大·范德格里夫特少将统率的美国海军陆战队击退了日本第35步兵旅的进攻；该旅由川口清健少将指挥。

en.s: Hurricane Gilbert was a large and extremely powerful tropical cyclone that formed during the 1988 Atlantic hurricane season, which peaked as a Category 5 hurricane.
